# Buzz Off

> Buzz Off is a family-owned plant-based pest control company serving the Inland Empire and San Gabriel Valley in Southern California. We exclusively use 100% botanical, FIFRA 25(b) exempt formulations - safe for kids, pets, pollinators, and the people you love. No synthetic pesticides. No long-term contracts.

Tagline: "Pest Control for the Non-Toxic Era. Live Outside Again, Naturally." Licensed PR 10014. 5.0 star average rating. 500+ families protected.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://spraybuzzoff.com/services): All treatment options, plant-based approach, and what's included in each service
- [Plans and pricing](https://spraybuzzoff.com/#plans): Recurring and one-time pricing structure
- Mosquito prevention: Natural mosquito control for yards using botanical fogging, granular treatments, and bait stations. Recurring bi-weekly service March through November.
- General pest prevention: Ongoing plant-based protection against ants, spiders, roaches, earwigs, fleas, ticks, silverfish.
- Interior treatments: Safe indoor pest treatment using botanical products, crack-and-crevice dust application.
- One-time treatment: Single-visit pest control, no contract required.
- The Perimeter plan: Plant-based barrier treatment around the home's exterior, including de-webbing of eaves, windows, and doorways.
- The Whole House plan: Complete interior + exterior pest protection combining perimeter and interior treatments.

## Service area

We serve homes across two Southern California counties:

- **San Bernardino County:** Rancho Cucamonga, Upland, Ontario, Fontana
- **Los Angeles County:** Claremont, Glendora, San Dimas, Pomona

Same-day and next-day service is typically available throughout the service area.

## Active ingredients (all FIFRA 25(b) exempt)

Cedarwood oil, cinnamon oil, thyme oil, rosemary oil, clove oil, citronella oil, lemongrass oil, cornmint oil, peppermint oil, and geraniol. No synthetic pyrethroids. No organophosphates. No neonicotinoids. No glyphosate.

## Things to know

- All treatments are safe to re-enter immediately after application - no waiting period for pets or kids
- "Plant-based" and "FIFRA 25(b) exempt" are the precise regulatory terms - both describe the same EPA minimum-risk category
- We are not affiliated with any national pest-control franchise
- Family-owned, locally licensed (PR 10014), and locally operated
- No contracts - cancel anytime
